brief:
The U.S. Board of Peace has failed to develop an effective humanitarian program more than a year into the Gaza ceasefire between Hamas and Israel, according to Dawn. The board's inability to establish a coherent aid framework has made UNRWA's continued role in the territory essential.

The gap in humanitarian assistance points to the necessity of established relief mechanisms already operating on the ground.
